title: Guidance for the Care of Human Remains in Museums (2005 edition)
author: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

notes.text: This record identifies the 2005 edition of the UK museum guidance on the care and return of human remains, relevant to MoSA's study of institutional return practices. The current GOV.UK page is marked updated 16 September 2026 and links the original document dated 11 October 2005; this record refers to that 2005 edition and does not treat it as current law or policy. No object identity is established. GOV.UK identifies Crown copyright and an Open Government Licence, subject to third-party material. A current-page capture was registered after review; it does not freeze the earlier edition. The OGL's third-party material exceptions apply.

captures.note: Reviewed official page title, Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport attribution, current 16 September 2026 update, guidance text and Open Government Licence notice. The capture is of the current GOV.UK page; it does not freeze the 2005 edition. OGL third-party material exceptions apply.
